title: Ecological Production Units — epu_sf
text: sf object containing spatial data Northeast US shelf Ecological Production Units (EPUs). Ecological Production Units (EPUs) delineate regions unique physiographic, oceanographic biotic aspects Northeast U.S. Continental Shelf, representing area approximately 264,000 km within 200 m isobath. four EPUs Shelf, including Mid-Atlantic Bight (MAB), Georges Bank (GB), Gulf Maine (GOM), Scotian Shelf (SS). Scotian Shelf lies outside management domain US Fishery Management Councils generally considered State Ecosystem Reports.
